calibration_v4.method: 1) exposure x neutral key grid (25 shots) vs Unreal v2_clean SIDE on the 3D-bench pixels -> e 13, key 1.0 (the SH from 8-bit faces misses the clipped lamp energy); 2) per-class grade in display-linear space after ACES (cushion / wood), iterated on the same pixels
calibration_v4.show_note: key for the during-show state scaled by the house wall/box light factor 0.06/0.70 -> 0.086; NOT measured against an Unreal render of the benches in that state
calibration_v4.grade_model: per class: x' = gain * (L + sat * (x - L)) in display-linear after ACES; [gain, sat, unused]
calibration_v4.rejected_2026-10-07: per-channel multipliers (up to x6.4 blue on wood) matched the medians of one frame but turned the wood blue and the cushions glossy at close range
calibration_v4.spec_wood_note: chosen visually against the Unreal-rendered benches in the same frame (row-in-front close-up): x1 reads as brushed metal, x0.15 as dark varnished wood
calibration_v4.show_gain_method: during-show: no Unreal render of the near benches exists; the ratio 3D cushion / background cushions nearby (excluding a 7 px ring around the 3D) measured in the calibrated pre-show state (0.748) is enforced in the show state (SIDE view): gain 0.183 (0.191 gave 0.782)
calibration_v4.show_gain_method_mono: 2026-10-09: the pre-state ratio carried over (gain 0.934) left the neighbour cushion ~3x brighter than every cushion in the mono background (median sRGB 117/50/50). Re-measured in the SIDE view (yaw -80, pitch -6): 3D cushion median vs lit background cushions in the same frame (45/25/21) -> gain 0.1 gives 42/18/18; tint saturation left as calibrated (sat 1.0 gave 51/4/3, too saturated)

show.note: 2026-11-18: Lear at CENTRE stage. Four audio-driven clips (OmniHuman 1.5, made in the set, v31 117.90-164.22 s), the man cut out (VEED) and laid on the clean plate with a contact shadow; then 4.8 s held, then the bow (Kling). 1528 frames, 25 fps, 544x960; bow_at_s = end of the speech | v d: 8 s lead-in (he stands and looks at the house while the curtain opens), 6-frame dissolves; 1728 frames | v e: picture | matte side by side (1088x960), show.alpha: only the man and his contact shadow are laid on the plate | v f: lead-in 10 s (curtain now 8 s + 1), 158 held frames, 1816 frames | v g: generated bridges (Kling, start/tail frames) fill the pauses at the 2nd and 3rd joins | v h: matte pulled in ~3 px and the bright rim inside his outline taken down (the director: remove the halo) | v i: a bridge at the first join too (three bridges, no dissolves) | v j: no held frame: he settles and keeps breathing after the speech and after the bow (existing footage, forward and back); 2046 frames

Clip prefiltered to 544x960 + aa 4 against shimmer. Previous placement: seat_live2_426_deep.json
show.note_2026_11_17_rug: the director: 'he must be at the FRONT OF THE RUG'. Rug front edge in the picture = face row 1567 (rug 1553.5-1567, boards to 1574, dark stage face below). Feet at row 1564.8 = 14.4 m at the set's floor height -0.27 (hall u -1.6). 1.73 m there = 6.8 deg. Clip prefiltered 408x720. The front-of-stage placement (9.6 m, off the rug) is kept in seat_live2_426_front.json
show.note_2026_11_17_k17: the director placed Lear himself with the joystick (hall u -2.28, w -14.26 = at the frame line, 14.4 m) and said 'keep the size you set' = x1.7 of model metres (2.94 m in model units; the opening = 5.3 of his heights, like a real drama theatre, cf. his Cameri photo). The headset read k 2.05 when he said it; 1.7 used. Set picture here = this morning's (furniture NOT yet enlarged x1.7).
